lines: Khote na hon jo hosh, unhein ghar bula ke pee
couplets.en: If you can keep your senses, invite them home and drink.

lines: Ya phir buton ko saamne apne bitha ke pee
couplets.en: Or sit the ones you adore across from you and drink.

lines: Behad na pee, na bol bahut, josh mein na aa
couplets.en: Drink in measure, speak little, and keep your composure.

lines: Ruk ruk ke pee, sukoon se pee, sar jhuka ke pee
couplets.en: Drink slowly, drink quietly, drink with your head bowed.

lines: Daulat hai faqat chaar dinon ki, pee le
couplets.en: Drink, for wealth lasts only a few days.

lines: Izzat hai faqat chaar dinon ki, pee le
couplets.en: Drink, for honor lasts only a few days.

lines: Hai waqt shab-o-roz tabahi ki taraf
couplets.en: Day and night, time carries us toward ruin.

lines: Mohlat hai faqat chaar dinon ki, pee le
couplets.en: Drink, for we have only a few days left.

lines: Chalo pee lein ke yaar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: Come, let us drink, for our beloved may never come.

lines: Yeh mausam baar baar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: This season may never come again.

lines: Chalo pee lein ke yaar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: Come, let us drink, for our beloved may never come.

lines: Gulabon ki tarah tum taaza rehna
couplets.en: May you stay as fresh as a rose.

lines: Zamane mein bahaar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: Spring may or may not return to the world.

lines: Yeh mausam baar baar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: This season may never come again.

lines: Chalo pee lein ke yaar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: Come, let us drink, for our beloved may never come.

lines: Yeh socha hai ke usko bhool jaayein
couplets.en: I have thought of letting their memory go.

lines: Ab is dil ko qaraar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: My heart may or may not find peace now.

lines: Yeh mausam baar baar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: This season may never come again.

lines: Chalo pee lein ke yaar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: Come, let us drink, for our beloved may never come.

lines: Zameer, is zindagi se kyun khafa ho?
couplets.en: Zameer, why do you hold a grudge against life?

lines: Ise phir tum pe pyaar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: Life may never look kindly on you again.

lines: Yeh mausam baar baar aaye na aaye
couplets.en: This season may never come again.
